import requests

def get_isoforms(acc):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json"
    r = requests.get(url).json()
    comments = r.get('comments', [])
    isoforms = []
    for c in comments:
        if c.get('commentType') == 'ALTERNATIVE PRODUCTS':
            for iso in c.get('isoforms', []):
                isoforms.append({
                    'name': iso.get('name', {}).get('value'),
                    'ids': iso.get('isoformIds')
                })
    return isoforms

print("HORMAD1 isoforms:", get_isoforms('Q86X24'))
print("INPP5K isoforms:", get_isoforms('Q9BT40'))

import requests

def get_isoform_mass(iso_id):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{iso_id}.fasta"
    r = requests.get(url)
    # calculate rough mass or fetch
    lines = r.text.strip().split('\n')
    seq = "".join(lines[1:])
    return len(seq)
